units.elevation: metres above publishedprofileminimum; absolute chart datum not reused

digitisation.gray_profile_method: Independent extraction of neutralgray profile stroke; 31pxmedian then33pxtriangular smoothing suppresses marker circles; nearby samples around extrema omitted to avoid calibration-marker spikes, redpeak marker gap interpolated. Sparse28pxchartcontrols plusallcorner/high/lowknots retained; monotone cubic Hermite interpolation evaluated at native stations.
digitisation.station_registration: Piecewise-linear chart-x registration between each labelledcorner and mapped/native plan controls; chart x spacing is not claimed metric. Nativeoriginpreserved.

layout_note: T1relativeclimb30.9m is independently stated in official article. Preserve rollingesses and backstraight crests by everycorner registration; no use of marketing133ft as surveyed roadheight.
limitations: Publisheddiagram is not an engineering/as-built survey. Smallresurfacingbumps, bankcrosssections and underpassdeckdetails need separatecontrols.
Graph/profile registration is approximate and depends on sourceplanlandmarks; do not claim geodetic precision from pixelreading.
